title: Visualisation of Multiple Tight Junctional Complexes in Human Airway Epithelial Cells
author: Buckley, Looi, et al.

steps.title: Coat coverslips
steps.instruction: Prepare glass coverslips by coating sequentially with 10 µg/mL fibronectin, 30 µg/mL collagen I, and 100 µg/mL BSA.

steps.title: Seed and culture cells
steps.instruction: Culture 16HBE14o‑ cells in MEM containing 10 % (v/v) FCS, 100 U/mL Penicillin/Streptomycin, and 1 % (v/v) L‑Glutamine at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂; seed 10 000 cells per coated coverslip and incubate until 100 % confluency, then continue for an additional 3 days.

steps.title: Triton X‑100 pre‑extraction
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with 0.2 % (v/v) Triton X‑100 in 1× TBS on ice for 10 min, then wash gently with 1× TBS for 30 min at room temperature, replacing the wash solution every 5 min.

steps.title: Fix cells
steps.instruction: Fix cells using one of the following methods: (i) 4 % (v/v) paraformaldehyde, (ii) 100 % methanol, (iii) acetone, or (iv) 1:1 methanol:acetone. For cells that underwent pre‑extraction, fixation is performed with either methanol or paraformaldehyde as described.

steps.title: Store fixed cells
steps.instruction: Place fixed cells in 1× TBS and store at 4 °C until further processing.

steps.title: Permeabilize with saponin
steps.instruction: Incubate cells with 0.1 % (v/v) saponin in 1× TBS after fixation (duration not specified).

steps.title: Stain tight junction proteins
steps.instruction: Stain the permeabilized cells for tight junction proteins (specific antibodies and conditions not provided).

steps.title: Confocal imaging
steps.instruction: Visualise the stained samples by confocal microscopy, compare and evaluate staining intensity of the tight junctional complexes.
